nodes.label: Engine DJ playlist writes paused
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home 0.72.3: playlist writes paused until made as Engine DJ does. GLUE wrote only into F: so playlists not shown in Engine DJ. Playlist edits and GLUE folder mirror run only with djPlaylists setting on.

nodes.label: One DJ sync at a time constraint
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home 0.72.1: timer's turn not restarted while sync runs. Every sync holds dj_one lock. Prevents duplicate playlist creation bug from 0.72.

nodes.label: Song that can't go to Engine DJ
nodes.rationale: Songs unable to sync show why (missing file, another computer's, no Engine DJ library on drive). Kept in GLUE's playlist with ! icon and reason line shown in view.
